create_reducer_subclass: create a subclass of Reducer that implements reduce, save_state, and load_state methods
implement_reduce_method: implement the reduce method in a Reducer subclass to aggregate results from a runner
use_mockreducer_for_testing: use MockReducer to test runner configuration without performing actual reduction logic
save_reducer_state: save the Reducer state to a checkpoint location for preemption recovery
load_reducer_state: load the Reducer state from a checkpoint location to resume reduction
